mapper.sql: so.id, so.outbound_no, so.order_id, so.order_no, so.outbound_source, so.total_quantity, so.total_amount, so.status, so.outbound_time, so.user_id, so.remark, so.create_by, so.update_by, so.create_time, so.update_time

FROM shop_erp_sale_outbound so LEFT JOIN sys_order o ON o.id = so.order_id AND so.outbound_source = 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN shop_erp_sale sal ON sal.id = so.order_id AND so.outbound_source = 2 AND sal.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = sal.store_id AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_purchase p ON p.id = so.order_id AND so.outbound_source = 3 AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_supplier s ON s.id = p.supplier_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = so.user_id
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(oi.outbound_quantity), 0) FROM shop_erp_sale_outbound_item oi WHERE oi.outbound_id = so.id AND oi.is_deleted = 0) AS totalOut

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_erp_sale_outbound_item i LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.outbound_id = so.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status IN (2, 3)) AS frozenRows

(SELECT d.id FROM shop_delivery d WHERE d.outbound_id = so.id AND d.outbound_no = so.outbound_no AND d.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS deliveryId, (SELECT d.delivery_no FROM shop_delivery d WHERE d.outbound_id = so.id AND d.outbound_no = so.outbound_no AND d.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS deliveryNo, (SELECT d.status FROM shop_delivery d WHERE d.outbound_id = so.id AND d.outbound_no = so.outbound_no AND d.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS deliveryStatus
mapper.select:
SELECT , , , o.status AS orderStatus, bu.nickname AS buyerName, st.store_name AS storeName, s.supplier_name AS supplierName, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE so.id = #{id} AND so.is_deleted = 0

SELECT , , st.store_name AS storeName, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE so.order_id = #{saleId} AND so.outbound_source = 2 AND so.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY so.id DESC
